The '''Oktos Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that skirted the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]]. It connected [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] to the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]] in the [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Astrography==
The Oktos Route began at [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], where it intersected the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']], [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']] and [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]].<ref name="TEA" />

The trade route passed through [[Kleeva]], [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] and [[Tol Amn]], and continued through the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga]] and [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It also passed through the [[Cygnus Star Empire]], a small collection of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that were situated only a few [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] apart in the Mid Rim, just [[Core Worlds/Legends|coreward]] of Hutt Space.<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

The Oktos Route ended in the Kurost sector, where it intersected the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]].<ref name="TEA" />

The trade route skirted the largely uncharted [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]], a [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] located in Hutt Space. It also skirted the [[Oktos sector/Legends|Oktos]] and [[Hune sector/Legends|Hune]] sectors of the Mid Rim.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet Toydaria was home to the [[Oktos Zone Imperial Outpost]], a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], whose [[hyperwave signal interceptor]]s could monitor [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] activity on the Otkos Route as far as Nal Hutta and Tol Amn.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in the aftermath of their [[Battle of Nal Hutta|conquest]] of the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref><ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] advanced along the Oktos Route in order to [[Attack on the Toydaria system|attack]] the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Oktos Route was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />

It was mentioned again in "[[The Written Word]]," a [[2010]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[John Hazlett]].<ref name="TWW" />

''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a [[2015]] supplement for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] series, mistakenly refers to the Oktos Route, the trade route passing through Toydaria, as the ''Shag Pabol''.<ref name="LoNH" />
